## Content inventory
Verified: Model L100, processor compliance, 16 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD, three-year onsite support, the 45 days delivery phases, named roles, and training for 10 administrators. OEM authorisation is pending. No ISO certification, past-project count, client testimonial, award, or final page number is supplied.

## Proposal structure
| Section | Planned pages | Purpose |
|---|---:|---|
| Cover and control | 1 | Tender and version identifiers |
| Executive summary | 1 | Evidence-led summary within 250 words |
| Understanding of scope | 2 | 100 laptops and service obligations |
| Compliance matrix | 3 | Requirement-to-evidence trace |
| Delivery methodology | 4 | 45-day phased execution |
| Training plan | 2 | 10 administrators |
| Onsite support | 3 | Three-year support workflow |
| Project organisation | 2 | Roles and escalation |
| Quality plan | 3 | Inspection and acceptance |
| Risk plan | 2 | Risks, controls, owners |
| Annexure index | 1 | Controlled attachments |
Keep the main proposal within 30 pages excluding annexures and use minimum 11-point font. Final pagination may rebalance these planned allocations.

## Executive summary
We propose Model L100 for the supply, installation, training, and three-year onsite support of 100 laptops. The verified configuration includes the supplied processor requirement, 16 GB RAM, and 512 GB SSD. Delivery follows a controlled 45-day sequence: mobilisation, staging, delivery, installation, then training and acceptance. A Project Manager coordinates the Logistics Lead, four Installation Engineers, and Trainer. Training equips 10 administrators for device administration and support escalation. The proposal maps each requirement to verified content and keeps unsupported claims out of the submission. OEM authorisation remains pending and must be obtained and approved before finalisation.

## Visual and production notes
Organisation chart: Project Manager above Logistics Lead, Installation Engineer team, and Trainer, without inventing reporting lines beyond coordination. Gantt chart: five supplied phases across days 1-45, with no fabricated overlap. Use consistent heading hierarchy, table styles, headers, footers, document ID, version, and accessible contrast. After content approval, render the proposal, perform visual QA for overflow, clipping, table splits, legibility, 30-page and 11-point compliance, then populate actual rendered page numbers and regenerate the table of contents. Require technical, document-control, and human approval before release.
